review_output: {"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR defects in the supplied scope. The own-key resolver `resolveDraft` uses `Object.hasOwn`. Both `generateMetadata` and the page component use it, so `constructor`, `toString` and `__proto__` produce empty metadata and `notFound()`. The unit tests cover that. The public policy component, which I read in full, shows the unpublished state with \"尚未發布\" and \"尚未公告\". It does not render draft sections, status or owner. The test that passes spoofed status and owner values asserts they are not echoed. Two things I could not verify: the e2e 404 test and the 6-case rerun are still pending, and I did not see `src/lib/public-policy-content`. I'm not certifying anything beyond this scope. Some Next versions put the `;404` part only in `error.digest`, and the message holds only the base code.
